name: Swiss Military Consumer Goods
summary: Swiss Military Consumer Goods Ltd. primarily engages in the commercialization of lifestyle products, encompassing their marketing, sales, distribution, and general trading. The company also aims to expand its operations into the commodity trading sector, with a focus on leveraging e-trading and e-handling technologies for new market prospects. This enterprise was established on January 25, 1989, and its corporate headquarters are situated in New Delhi, India.
